name: whisper-large-v3-sk
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-large-v3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of openai/whisper-large-v3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.543 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-06-23. CAVEATS: Slovak only. Two tables on the card: the CV24 table carries both this model and openai/whisper-large-v3 in the same columns; the second table is a per-size sweep with Fine-tuned/Base WER columns.
